mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months indicates strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5%, signals a strong labor market, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the previous quarter signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained increase over the previous quarter.
